data.notes_barbara:
Different products; Different functional buyers; Different customer focus

Sprinklr serves enterprise marketing and customer-service teams. Its products and functional buyers differ from HR/payroll.
data.notes_matthew: Sprinklr is customer experience software for marketing teams at big enterprises. No human resources angle.

data.reason: Paylocity sells HR, payroll and finance/IT software to employers, mainly mid-sized US firms. Sprinklr sells a customer experience management platform (social, marketing, care, research) to large global brands. The products differ, and so do the buyers: HR and payroll teams versus marketing and customer service teams. Both sell subscription cloud software, but that is the only link.

Different customers and applications: Sprinklr serves marketing, customer experience and customer service teams; Paylocity serves internal HR, payroll, finance and IT needs. Shared platform and automation language does not establish competition.
